h1: Custom Infant Caps for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom infant caps for your brand. Perfect for baby showers, hospital giveaways & events. Bulk pricing available.
introHtml: Custom infant caps are sized specifically for newborns and toddlers, making them a thoughtful giveaway for hospital welcome kits, baby showers, or family-friendly corporate events. These caps are typically made from soft, breathable cotton or polyester blends to ensure comfort for delicate skin. Decorate with embroidery or screen printing for a subtle logo placement that parents will appreciate. Choose from adjustable or stretch-fit styles to accommodate growing heads.
heroAltText: Custom infant caps in soft cotton with embroidered logo, ideal for baby shower favors and hospital welcome gifts.
